name: extract-facts
description: Extract single-entity attribute facts from a passage of text and persist them as knowledge graph fact nodes. Self-classifies internally — always safe to call; exits early if no facts are found.

inputs.text: string (the message or turn text to extract facts from)
inputs.subject_contact_id: string? (optional contact UUID for the conversation's counterpart. Used ONLY to break a tie when a subject name matches several entities of the same type, and only when one of them is that contact's own node. Not a claim that every extracted fact is about this contact.)
inputs.max_stored: number? (optional cap on facts persisted in this invocation)

outputs.stored: number (new or updated fact nodes persisted to the KG)
outputs.redirected: number (canonical contact attribute writes redirected to ContactService instead of KG)
outputs.skipped: boolean (true if the classifier gate determined no facts were present)
outputs.failed: number (facts that could not be persisted due to errors)
outputs.ambiguous: number (facts dropped because the subject name matched several same-type entities and nothing could break the tie — distinct from `failed`: nothing malfunctioned, and the fix is to supply subject_contact_id or disambiguate the entities, not to retry)
